SLOT gestureSlots INSERT TEMPLATE swipes{
	id:swipeForToolbar
	distance:0.3 
	releaseRequired: false
	direction: {if (toolbar.expanded){
		if (toolbar.position == 0 )  {
			return  Qt.point( 0,  -1);
		}
		else if (toolbar.position == 1){
			return  Qt.point( 1,  0);
		}
		
		else if (toolbar.position == 2){
			return  Qt.point( 0,  1);
		}
		
		else if (toolbar.position == 3){
		    return  Qt.point( -1,  0);
		}
		}
	else{
		if (toolbar.position == 0 )  {
			return  Qt.point( 0,  1);
		}
		else if (toolbar.position == 1){
			return  Qt.point( -1,  0);
		}
		
		else if (toolbar.position == 2){
			return  Qt.point( 0,  -1);
		}
		
		else if (toolbar.position == 3){
			return  Qt.point( 1,  0);
		}
	}}
	conditionName: something 
	condition: false
	areas: {
			
	if (toolbar.expanded){
		if (toolbar.position == 0 )  {
			return  Qt.rect(0,0,touchArea.width , 4*touchArea.edgeSize);
		}
		else if (toolbar.position == 1){
			return  Qt.rect(touchArea.width, 0,-4*touchArea.edgeSize, touchArea.height);
		}
		
		else if (toolbar.position == 2){
			return  Qt.rect(0,touchArea.height,touchArea.width, -4*touchArea.edgeSize);
		}
		
		else if (toolbar.position == 3){
			return  Qt.rect(0,0,4*touchArea.edgeSize, touchArea.height);
		}
		}
	else{
		if (toolbar.position == 0 )  {
			return  Qt.rect(0,0,touchArea.width , touchArea.edgeSize);
		}
		else if (toolbar.position == 1){
			return  Qt.rect(touchArea.width-touchArea.edgeSize, 0,touchArea.edgeSize, touchArea.height);
		}
		
		else if (toolbar.position == 2){
			return  Qt.rect(0,touchArea.height-touchArea.edgeSize,touchArea.width, touchArea.edgeSize);
		}
		
		else if (toolbar.position == 3){
			return  Qt.rect(0,0,touchArea.edgeSize, touchArea.height);
		}
	}
			}
	fingers:1
	action: {toolbar.expanded = !toolbar.expanded;}
}
END SLOT
